description: Find the magnitude and direction of the resultant of forces at a point, or a force that makes a component zero.
name: Resultant of coplanar forces

description: Several coplanar forces acting at a point are in equilibrium; find unknown forces or angles (no strings or planes).
name: Forces at a point in equilibrium

description: A particle or smooth ring held by strings, ropes or struts; resolve or use Lami to find tensions, masses, angles.
name: Particle in equilibrium: strings / ring on a string

description: Particle on a rough horizontal floor or table: limiting friction, or motion against friction.
name: Friction on a horizontal surface

description: Particle at rest or on the point of moving on a rough or smooth incline; find a force, range of P or least mu.
name: Inclined plane: equilibrium / limiting friction

description: Newton's second law up or down a rough or smooth slope, usually followed by constant-acceleration formulae.
name: Motion on an inclined plane

description: A ring or bead threaded on a fixed rough rod or wire, in equilibrium or in motion.
name: Ring or bead on a rod / wire

description: F = ma for a single particle on a level line or moving vertically (not on a plane or with friction).
name: Force and motion in a straight line

description: Atwood machine: two particles on a string over a fixed pulley, both hanging; string breaks or a particle hits the floor.
name: Pulley: two particles hanging

description: One particle on a horizontal table or an inclined plane, connected over a pulley at the edge to a hanging particle.
name: Pulley: particle on table / plane + hanging particle

description: Particles on two faces of a wedge connected over a pulley at the top, or three particles with two strings.
name: Pulley: two inclined planes / three particles

description: Two particles joined by a string or rod and pulled along a surface or slope; tension, string breaks.
name: Connected particles in a line (no pulley)

description: Vehicle towing a trailer, caravan or coach through a tow-bar or coupling: acceleration, tension or thrust.
name: Car and trailer / towing

description: Lift accelerating or decelerating: cable tension and reaction between floor and load.
name: Lift / elevator

description: Car, lorry, cyclist or train with driving force or power against resistance, on the level or a hill.
name: Vehicles: driving force, power P = Fv, maximum speed

description: Use kinetic and potential energy with work done against resistance on a slope, slide or curved path.
name: Work-energy on a slope or path

description: W = Fd cos(theta), rate of working of a force (not a vehicle engine), average power.
name: Work done by a force and average power

description: Several stages of constant acceleration; sketch or use a v-t or s-t graph, total distance, unknown time or speed.
name: Velocity-time graph / multi-stage journey

description: Two bodies moving on the same line; when or where they meet, catch up or are furthest apart.
name: Two vehicles / catching up

description: A single stage of constant acceleration, e.g. passing points A, B, C with given times or distances.
name: Constant acceleration formulae (suvat)

description: Projected vertically or dropped: greatest height, time above a height, two particles, bounce.
name: Vertical motion under gravity

description: v, s or a given as a function of t: differentiate or integrate, times at rest, total distance.
name: Variable acceleration (calculus)

description: Conservation of momentum in direct impact, coalescence, kinetic energy lost, further collisions or a wall.
name: Collisions and momentum

description: Radian, angular speed, centripetal acceleration and force for motion in a horizontal circle.
name: Circular motion: radians, angular speed, horizontal circle

description: Mass on a string or track in a vertical circle: tension or reaction at top and bottom.
name: Vertical circle

description: Gravitational force as centripetal force: orbital speed or period, Kepler T^2 = kr^3, geostationary orbit.
name: Orbits and geostationary satellites

description: Newton's law of gravitation, field strength, gravitational potential and potential energy.
name: Gravitational field and potential

description: Thermodynamic scale, absolute zero, thermal equilibrium, thermometers.
name: Temperature scales and thermal equilibrium

description: Energy to change temperature or state; heating curves and experiments.
name: Specific heat capacity and latent heat

description: pV = nRT and pV = NkT: amount of gas, temperature, pressure or volume changes.
name: Ideal gas equation

description: Assumptions of kinetic theory, pV = Nm<c^2>/3, mean kinetic energy and r.m.s. speed of molecules.
name: Kinetic theory of gases, r.m.s. speed

description: Internal energy, work done on a gas, first law; gas cycles.
name: Internal energy and the first law of thermodynamics

description: Defining equation, displacement, velocity and acceleration graphs, energy in s.h.m.
name: Simple harmonic motion

description: Light, critical and heavy damping; forced oscillations and resonance.
name: Damping and resonance

description: Coulomb's law, field strength and potential of point charges and spheres, uniform fields between plates.
name: Electric field and potential

description: Deflection of electrons or ions in fields, velocity selector, circular path in a magnetic field, oil drop.
name: Charged particle in electric / magnetic fields

description: Definition of capacitance, series and parallel combinations, energy stored.
name: Capacitors: capacitance, networks and energy

description: Exponential discharge through a resistor, time constant RC, graphs of Q, V or I against t.
name: Capacitor discharge and time constant

description: F = BIL, F = Bqv, flux density, Hall voltage, fields due to wires and solenoids.
name: Magnetic force on wires and charges, Hall effect

description: Magnetic flux and flux linkage, Faraday's and Lenz's laws, induced e.m.f.
name: Electromagnetic induction

description: Sinusoidal a.c., peak and r.m.s. values, mean power, half- and full-wave rectification and smoothing.
name: Alternating current, r.m.s. values and rectification

description: Photon energy and momentum, work function, threshold frequency, Einstein equation.
name: Photoelectric effect and photons

description: Discrete electron energy levels, emission and absorption line spectra.
name: Energy levels and line spectra

description: De Broglie wavelength, electron diffraction as evidence for the wave nature of particles.
name: Wave-particle duality: de Broglie, electron diffraction

description: Mass-energy equivalence, binding energy per nucleon curve, energy released in nuclear reactions.
name: Mass defect, binding energy, fission and fusion

description: Random and spontaneous decay, decay constant, half-life, activity, exponential decay.
name: Radioactive decay, half-life and activity

description: Piezo-electric transducer, acoustic impedance, intensity reflection coefficient, attenuation.
name: Ultrasound imaging

description: Production of X-rays, attenuation, image sharpness and contrast, computed tomography.
name: X-rays and CT scanning

description: Positron emission tomography: tracer, annihilation, gamma photons.
name: PET scanning and tracers

description: 2019-21 syllabus: NMRI, Larmor frequency, uniform and non-uniform magnetic fields, relaxation.
name: Nuclear magnetic resonance imaging (legacy)

description: Luminosity and radiant flux intensity, standard candles, Wien's law, Stefan-Boltzmann law, stellar radii.
name: Stellar luminosity, standard candles, Wien and Stefan-Boltzmann

description: Doppler redshift of galaxies, Hubble constant, expanding universe.
name: Redshift, Hubble's law and the Big Bang

description: 2019-21 syllabus: ideal op-amp, inverting and non-inverting amplifiers, comparators, sensors, output devices.
name: Op-amps and sensing circuits (legacy)

description: 2019-21 syllabus: AM/FM, bandwidth, analogue and digital signals, attenuation in dB, channels.
name: Communication: modulation, signals, attenuation (legacy)
